<!-- Generated from @@SOURCE_NAME@@. Edit the dashboard or PDF template, then regenerate. -->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Use the same period keys as the pre-rendered CCISS map filenames.
valid_periods <- c("2001_2020", "2021_2040", "2041_2060", "2061_2080", "2081_2100")
period <- params$time_period
# Quarto parses CLI parameters as YAML: an unquoted 2041_2060 becomes
# the integer 20412060. Map only the five known numeric forms back to keys.
if (is.numeric(period) && length(period) == 1L && !is.na(period)) {
  numeric_periods <- as.numeric(gsub("_", "", valid_periods, fixed = TRUE))
  matched_period <- match(period, numeric_periods)
  if (!is.na(matched_period)) period <- valid_periods[matched_period]
}
if (!is.character(period) || length(period) != 1L || is.na(period) ||
    !period %in% valid_periods) {
  stop("Invalid params$time_period. Choose one of: ",
       paste(valid_periods, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
period_label <- gsub("_", "-", period, fixed = TRUE)
fig_path <- @@FIG_PATH_R@@
edatope <- params$edatope
if (!is.character(edatope) || length(edatope) != 1L || is.na(edatope) ||
    !edatope %in% c("all", "C4", "B2", "D6")) {
  stop("Invalid params$edatope. Choose one of: all, C4, B2, D6.", call. = FALSE)
}
edatopes <- if (edatope == "all") c("C4", "B2", "D6") else edatope
edatope_labels <- c(C4 = "Medium/mesic (C4)", B2 = "Poor/subxeric (B2)",
                    D6 = "Rich/hygric (D6)")[edatopes]
orientation <- if (edatope == "all") "landscape" else "portrait"
# knitr passes this dependency into Pandoc's preamble, before page layout is set.
# No generated/shared configuration file is needed between renders.
knitr::knit_meta_add(list(rmarkdown::latex_dependency(
  "geometry", extra_lines = sprintf("\\geometry{letterpaper,%s,margin=0.6in}", orientation)
)))
historic_files <- @@HISTORIC_FILES_R@@[edatopes]
projection_by_period <- @@PROJECTION_FILES_R@@
projection_files <- projection_by_period[[period]][edatopes]
bubble_files <- @@BUBBLE_FILES_R@@[edatopes]
area_files <- @@AREA_FILES_R@@[edatopes]
pie_file <- @@PIE_FILE_R@@
required_files <- file.path(fig_path, c(historic_files, projection_files,
                                      bubble_files, area_files, pie_file))
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
if (length(missing_files)) {
  stop("Missing figure files: ", paste(missing_files, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}

# Non-floating minipages keep the selected images together on a single row.
# Paths are relative to this document, so rendering also works from the repo root.
figure_row <- function(files) {
  stopifnot(length(files) == length(edatopes))
  cat("\\begin{center}\n")
  panel_width <- if (length(edatopes) == 3L) "0.325" else "0.65"
  for (i in seq_along(files)) {
    cat("\\begin{minipage}[t]{", panel_width, "\\linewidth}\\centering\n",
        "\\textbf{", edatope_labels[i], "}\\par\\smallskip\n",
        "\\includegraphics[width=\\linewidth]{", file.path(fig_path, files[i]), "}\n",
        "\\end{minipage}", if (i < length(files)) "\\hfill\n" else "\n",
        sep = "")
  }
  cat("\\end{center}\n")
}
```

**Selected map period: `r period_label`**

**Edatopes shown: `r paste(edatope_labels, collapse = "; ")`**
